build_method: python build.py --jobs 3: lake build of the imported Tau Ceti modules and of the vendored complexitylib library, then all local sources compiled with lake env lean and dependency-sensitive source fingerprints
public_dependencies: Pinned public Lake dependencies (lake-manifest.json): .lake/packages is a directory junction to the .lake/packages of the development project, which holds the same revisions, with Mathlib objects from the public Mathlib build cache. No compiled local module was reused.
